scope: Additional public-source triage. These candidates are not acquired training data and are separate from the pinned acquired-source registry.

candidates.creator: Shuhao He
candidates.capture: Industrial-camera surface inspection with a black support and ring lighting; not an observed growth sequence through solution
candidates.annotation_status: Publisher instructions describe annotating images with LabelImg; supplied label files are not verified
candidates.access_observation: The fetched primary page requires a subscription and shows no downloadable files in the unauthenticated file section
candidates.decision: Keep as an optional surface-inspection lead. Do not equate its surface defects with in-growth secondary nucleation, asymmetry or inclusion-onset labels. No subscription, login or author contact performed.

candidates.capture: Brightfield and polarized micrographs paired with Raman measurements across five microfluidic experiment sets
candidates.labels: Raman-grounded polymorph classes and image positions; the record describes a trained Cellpose model, not a verified seed/event annotation export
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 stated by deposit description
candidates.decision: Related-material auxiliary lead only. Prioritize reviewing the already acquired crystal data and KDP capture coverage before another unrelated-material acquisition.

remaining_target_gap: No newly verified public source here supplies representative timestamped KDP tank-growth masks, the three pitch event labels and paired actuator-response logs. User equipment/capture access remains an open dependency.
